section_new.excerpt: ## Why event order is part of the model Two events at the same timestamp can produce different results depending on which is processed first. A service completion at t=1.0 and a timeout at t=1.0 are the same timestamp. If the completion is processed first, the request succeeds. If the timeout is processed first, the request fails and may retry. A model that relies on dictionary iteration order or an unstable sort is not reproducible. The V12 event queue orders by time, then priority, then insertion sequence. The insertion sequence is a monotonically increasing integer, so the order is total and deterministic.
